ابتهجوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَهَجُوا (ibtahajū) /ib.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اُبْتُهِجُوا (ubtuhijū) /ub.tu.hi.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اِبْتَهِجُوا (ibtahijū) /ib.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
